entities.name: High-grade MPNST
observations: For an upper-extremity high-grade MPNST after R1 resection, postoperative RT is guided by high-grade extremity soft-tissue sarcoma principles; microscopic residual disease warrants a boost above the initial 50 Gy course.

entities.name: R1 postoperative dose
observations: ARST1321 explicitly recommends a 16 Gy postoperative boost after R1 resection, producing a cumulative dose of 66 Gy.
NCCN-linked dosing supports 50 Gy plus 16–18 Gy for microscopically positive margins, approximately 66–68 Gy; gross residual disease receives higher doses.

entities.name: MPNST postoperative RT
observations: A retrospective MPNST series reported a median postoperative RT dose of 64 Gy, supporting a mid-60-Gy postoperative dose and distinguishing it from median 50 Gy preoperative RT.
